key_insight: OpenPVMapper combines multiple complementary sources to build the first open, nationwide installation-level database of rooftop PV systems in mainland France.
engineering_relevance: The dataset can support grid planning, PV adoption analysis, and large-scale solar forecasting by providing geolocated, source-traced rooftop PV installations with capacity estimates.
method: Run a deep-learning detector on nationwide aerial imagery.
Reconcile detections with OpenStreetMap and a probabilistic building-level dataset.
Attach provenance, detection method, and manual-validation flags to each installation.
evidence_signal: The database contains 1,135,850 installations totaling about 15.01 GWp, and a stratified manual review of 1,862 installations estimates overall precision at roughly 74–75% with improvement from cross-source corroboration.
watch_item: Precision is still imperfect and coverage depends on source availability and reconciliation quality, so some installations may be missed or duplicated.
paper_title: OpenPVMapper: A Multi-source, Nationwide Database of Rooftop Photovoltaic Systems in France
